name: Fennel Pondweed
desc: Fennel Pondweed (Stuckenia pectinata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 25 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Stuckenia pectinata, commonly called sago pondweed or fennel pondweed, and sometimes called ribbon weed, is a cosmopolitan water plant species that grows in fresh and brackish water on all continents…
